scripts.build: pnpm --filter @workspace/tin-tuc-portal run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.cpSync('artifacts/tin-tuc-portal/dist', 'dist', {recursive:true}); fs.cpSync('artifacts/tin-tuc-portal/dist', 'public', {recursive:true}); ['app.js','server.js','index.js'].forEach(f => { try{fs.copyFileSync(f, 'dist/'+f); fs.copyFileSync(f, 'public/'+f);}catch(e){} });"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
